name: Nsite Archive
summary: Local nsite discovery, verified archive, full-text search, history comparison and restoration with confirmed campaign exclusion.

help.purpose: Find, preserve, search and restore signed nsite publications.
help.start: Open Collect to discover sites or import signed events; open Backup to restore an existing full archive.
help.limitations: Browser repair verified on local fixtures; installed Android APK and live relay/CORS collection remain unverified. HTTPS or supported WebView origin is needed for service-worker offline startup.
help.data: Archive bytes and provenance stay on this browser origin. Configured relays, servers and an explicitly selected proxy see retrieval requests. Nothing is published.
